name: GET /api/fda/product-codes/:code - classification of a product code
description: Returns device class and regulation number for a three-letter FDA product code (case-insensitive) from our copy of the FDA classification database, with device name, specialty, review panel, submission type, implant and life-sustaining flags, how many 510(k)s our copy holds for the code and the latest decision date, a link to the FDA classification record and the as-of dates. Covers: a product code returns device class and regulation number. Needs the FDA copy loaded (npm run fda:bulk -- classification 510k recall; npm run fda:sync -- event_counts); test values are real FDA records: K031698 (Roche, cleared 2003-08-20), product code FRN (infusion pump, class 2, 21 CFR 880.5725), K251636 (FRN, named in recall Z-1368-2026).

errorCases.when: code does not match the FDA format

errorCases.message: not in our copy of the FDA data
errorCases.when: well-formed code that the FDA copy does not hold
